_comment: Mutation testing for the MCP server (AI assistants reading data on behalf of the signed-in user). WHY THESE FILES: this is an outward-facing door to the whole dataset, and its failures are silent in the wrong direction -- a token check that accepts one audience too many, a scope test that passes on a missing claim, a permission filter that lists a tool the caller may not use, a row cap that stops capping. Each would still answer every happy-path request correctly. Scoped like the sibling API configs: these files plus their own fully-mocked unit tests (no filesystem outside the sandbox, no PostgreSQL, no Entra). MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral disabled, matching the sibling API configs. Run: cd app/api && npm run test:mutation:mcp. NOT YET MEASURED: this config ships with the feature; `break` is deliberately absent until a first run measures a score (Stryker's vitest runner does not activate mutants on the Windows workstation this was written on). Add `{ pkg: api, name: mcp, label: 'API MCP server' }` to .github/workflows/js-mutation.yml once it is measured, and set the floor a few points under what it reports.
